_about: Team Terminus roster on the studio page (studio#roster). build.py renders it in English and Dutch (roles stay in English, like the team cards). 'account' is the player's account name: when set, the name links to their profile (player?u=<account>). Profile ribbons do NOT come from this file: they come from the account service's own team list, tied to each member's Discord sign-in. Add groups in display order; an empty group is skipped. 'in_game_from' is the release that shows the Twin T beside team names in game; the intro mentions it once that release is out. 'name' (optional) is shown after the callsign.
